title: I’m split
body: On one hand, it’s kinda cool to collect movies like Pokemon cards. On the other, turning the love of movies into a rarity-based, chance-based, exclusive, time-limited, gambling game takes some of the coolness out. Many titles are extremely limited so your only chance to get them are to pay other players for their copies, which means you’ll never be able to collect them all. And of course it’s your favorite movies that are gonna be 1.5M coins to purchase from another player. But the profiles aren’t really cool enough to make a nice display of what you have to collecting means very little in the end. It’s pay to win in the most literal sense. But, if you love movies, every second in this app is simply a good time. The games are great and challenging, and having the movies in your collection is simply rad, even if the movies are trash. I just wish it wasn’t such a “deal with the devil” to play.

title: Fun but bad in-game economy
body: I enjoy this game but the movies/cards have a wildly unfair tier system. Many of their “rarest” cards are only obtainable through paid season passes, forking out an absurd amount of in-game currency, or you have a very slight chance of getting one via a loot box. Of course they’re rare, and getting them should be rare. But most of these card collecting games ensure all players can get an exclusive card periodically. A better system might include a guaranteed random top-tier card once per month. There are still many many movies hidden in that tier, so people would still play in the hopes of getting a favorite. It just feels like a broken aspect of their in-game economy. I’ve opened like 25 of their “ultimate” boxes at this point and don’t have a single one. It’s just discouraging for a new user, and I will likely uninstall soon. Hope they reconsider going forward, cheers.

title: Great Game
body: Although there is still work to be done on the game, I can completely see the potential. I really hope to see this game succeed and have a great community. I have only played the game for about 5 minutes and there are a few visual errors, most of them being how the text in some areas is referring to shoes. I really hope those bugs get fixed soon. Thanks so much for reading my review, and to the developer, I think it would be cool to have more things new to the game instead of from boxed up, but it’s fine if you don’t add, I really like both games. Edit : there are also bugs in the games, for example in the guess the movie game some of the options were shoes. Overall the main problem is that a lot of things from boxed up are in the new game for some reason. If those get fixed, the game is going to be great I can feel it. Also all the movies show the exact same worth and heat for some reason. So sorry for the long review
